title: Identification of phosphorylation site on PARP1 mediating its cytosolic translocation in virus-infected HeLa cells
author: Wang, Ma, et al.
materials: Goat Anti-Rabbit IgG Antibody, HRP conjugate
Goat Anti-Mouse IgG Antibody, HRP conjugate
and monkey kidney epithelial cells (Vero; ATCC CCL81.

steps.title: Prepare complete growth medium
steps.instruction: Make Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM, Gibco) supplemented with 10% (v/v) heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum (Gibco), 1% (v/v) penicillin–streptomycin, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 2 mM L‑glutamine, 10 mM HEPES buffer, and 50 µM 2‑mercaptoethanol (all Gibco).

steps.title: Culture HeLa and Vero cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and expand human cervical cancer cells (HeLa, ATCC CCL‑2) and monkey kidney epithelial cells (Vero, ATCC CCL81.4) in the prepared medium, maintaining cultures at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO₂.

steps.title: Confirm mycoplasma‑free status
steps.instruction: Test each cell line for mycoplasma contamination using the LookOut Mycoplasma PCR Detection Kit (MP0035, Sigma‑Aldrich) and retain only mycoplasma‑negative cultures.

steps.title: Seed cells in glass‑bottom dishes
steps.instruction: Plate cells into 15 mm glass‑bottom culture dishes (NEST, Jiangsu, China) at approximately 3 × 10⁵ cells per dish so that they reach 70–80 % confluence at the time of transfection.

steps.title: Prepare DNA‑lipid transfection mix
steps.instruction: Dilute 2–5 µL Lipofectamine 2000 reagent and 1–2 µg of the appropriate PARP1 plasmid each in 125 µL Opti‑MEM medium; combine the diluted DNA with the diluted Lipofectamine (1:1 ratio) and incubate the mixture for 5 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Lipofectamine 2000 (2–5 µL) in 125 µL Opti‑MEM.
Dilute PARP1 plasmid DNA (1–2 µg) in a separate 125 µL Opti‑MEM.
Mix the two dilutions 1:1 and let stand for 5 min.

steps.title: Transfect cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the DNA‑lipid complex to the seeded cells, then incubate the cultures at 37 °C for 36 h.

steps.title: Infect cells with HSV‑1
steps.instruction: After the 36‑h post‑transfection incubation, infect the cells with HSV‑1 virus at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 1.

steps.title: Generate phospho‑PARP1T594 antibody
steps.instruction: Raise a rabbit polyclonal antibody against PARP1 phosphorylated at threonine 594 (p‑PARP1T594) in collaboration with Abclonal Biotech: immunize three rabbits with the phosphorylated peptide c(KLH)-591RVG(p‑T)VIGSNK600 (phospho‑Thr at a 1:1 ratio) and later purify and validate the antibody using the non‑phosphorylated peptide c(KLH)-591RVGTVIGSNK600.

substeps.instruction: Immunize three rabbits with peptide c(KLH)-591RVG(p‑T)VIGSNK600.
Use the non‑phosphorylated peptide c(KLH)-591RVGTVIGSNK600 for antibody purification and detection.
